parsed.summary: This PR loosens the review rules in the same change as a small payments text edit, and the new rules should not be used to judge it. The note text change has no test that checks it, and no requirement is linked.

findings.title: PR weakens review-policy.yml in the same change it wants to pass
findings.detail: The policy file says it is read from the base revision only. This PR empties critical_paths (line 3), policy_paths (line 6) and required_checks (line 7), turns off the per-workflow test rule (line 9), and lets any Low change auto-merge on all paths (line 14). The author's claim that the PR is Low and auto-merge eligible only holds under the new rules. Under the base rules, src/payments/** is a critical path, and a policy file edit is itself guarded. This needs a human review under the base policy. It should not auto-merge, and it should be split from the ledger edit.
findings.suggestedCheck: Split the policy change into its own PR. Re-classify the ledger edit using the base review-policy.yml, where src/payments/** is critical.

findings.title: The changed note text is not checked by any test
findings.detail: postCharge() now returns note "charge was posted" instead of "charge posted". The only ledger test checks amountCents and never reads note. The code index shows no callers of postCharge(), but it may miss things such as string matches on the note in reports or other systems. The author says amounts and validation are unchanged. That is plausible from the diff, but the passing test only covers the amount for a valid input, not the rejection of bad input.
findings.suggestedCheck: Search the repo and downstream consumers for the old string "charge posted". Add a test that asserts the note value and one that checks postCharge rejects a negative or non-integer amount.

couldNotDecide.question: Which requirement does this change serve? No requirement is linked, so REVIEW.md item 1 cannot be met.
couldNotDecide.checkThatWouldHelp: The author links a requirement ID, and the policy change gets its own requirement and approval.

couldNotDecide.question: Does anything outside the indexed code read the note text, such as exports, logs or other services?
couldNotDecide.checkThatWouldHelp: A repo-wide search for "charge posted", plus a check with the owners of ledger consumers.
